item.title: Turkey’s economic growth trajectory
item.description: Turkey's economic trajectory since 1990 has been one of significant but highly volatile expansion. After a period of slow growth in the 1990s, Turkey saw a major economic takeoff beginning around 2000, with GDP soaring from $273 billion to reach a peak of $867 billion by 2015, driven largely by capital accumulation and liberalization efforts.
